_comment: FAKE example applicant. Copy to $PIPELINE_HOME/profile.json and replace every value with your own. This file is the single source of truth for every fact typed into an application: agents may select, reorder and phrase these facts, never invent new ones. A question whose answer is not here must be PARKED for you to answer.

contact.address: 123 Example Street, Springfield, IL 62701, United States

experiences.title: Software Engineering Intern
experiences.description:
Built an internal REST service in Go that replaced a nightly batch job.
Added integration tests and CI checks for the service.

experiences.title: Teaching Assistant, Data Structures
experiences.description: Teaching Assistant for an undergraduate data structures course.

projects.name: Example Project
projects.description: A small key-value store written in Rust with a write-ahead log.

education.gpaPolicy: fill only when the GPA field is required

workAuthorization._comment: Answer each question exactly as asked. These are examples, not advice: fill in your real situation.

eeo._comment: Voluntary self-identification. 'Decline to answer' is always an acceptable choice.
eeo.veteran: I am not a protected veteran
eeo.disability: No, I do not have a disability

howDidYouHear.freeText: I found the posting on your website.

locationPreference.fallback: prefer a major city over suburban/rural sites
locationPreference.multiSelect: tick all acceptable locations, preferred ones first/primary

standardAnswers._comment: Routine screening questions with an obvious answer. Anything not covered here or elsewhere in this file is PARKED for a human.

neverWrite: _comment: facts that must never appear on a form, e.g. a course listed on the résumé that is still in progress must be written as '(in progress)'.
writingSample: Optional: a short paragraph in your own voice. Essay-writing subagents match its tone and structure.
writingStyle: no em dashes or spaced en dashes in typed text; use commas, periods, colons or parentheses
